hypothesis_origin: Current fixed qualitative review identified honorific fragments, open quotation boundaries, and attribution/provider-recipient errors. These are retrospective motivation for a future study, not new confirmatory current-holdout results.
future_label_design: Keep a quote-aware display unit as context; enumerate every atomic proposition rather than assuming one whole quotation is one fact.
Separately assess accurate quotation content, attributed speaker or actor, and the surrounding claimed relationship.
For a transfer relation, explicitly bind provider, recipient and transferred object; unresolved roles remain unknown.
Require exact source paragraph/character evidence and full-argument assertion scope; mechanical evidence validation does not establish semantic entailment.
Preserve mixed units, disagreement, missing assertions and unaccepted units in coverage. Preserve full reasons with no arbitrary character limit.
Do not derive factual truth or deceptive intent from assigned advocacy or answer choice.
next_development_steps: Review the complete45response parser outputs, including abbreviations and post-quotation attribution; current regression fixtures are structural examples, not human validation of every natural unit.

In a separately approved development study, annotate all staged units blind to role/gold/probe scores with explicit atomic relation fields; compare agreement, unresolved coverage and evidence correctness before training.
Use the environment development-only coherent source-world pairs for identical-text factual interventions and counterbalance relation directions and unit position; keep family grouping intact.

If development warrants another model fit, predeclare candidates, select only on development families, and compare against old head, text, random-direction, position/length and response-broadcast controls.

Freeze the next unit definition, aggregation, detector and evaluation before a new untouched test set is opened. The existing24-family results cannot validate a hypothesis derived from their inspection.
runtime_before_any_future_calls: Recount every complete input and prospective output, including atomic proposition multiplicity, model context allowance, transport timeout and worst-case reservation.
Re-extract compatible full-context features if new unit boundaries require unavailable token pools; do not approximate arbitrary new units from old sentence means.
Keep full sources, arguments, every unit, diagnostics and unknown/disagreement coverage; preserve normal-stop receipts and treat truncated generations as incomplete.
limits: A heuristic quotation-aware unit is not necessarily an atomic claim.
Uppercase post-quotation attribution, abbreviations, ambiguous apostrophes and malformed quotes still require review.
Unit enumeration completeness and evidence entailment cannot be established by mechanical validation.
Current holdout motivated these future hypotheses; no confirmatory claim or current metric is recomputed.
Future arbitrary unit pools require compatible token-level features or new full-context extraction, independent annotation and a new freeze; current pooled sentence vectors are insufficient.
